text:
alex: Quick PSA - local smoke tests showed a 404 on runtime guide link: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/v2/kvcache. Anyone owning runtime guide v2? Thinking a small redirect or examples tweak.

maya: I can look. Which page and example did you hit?

alex: The "Configuring KV cache" section on the runtime guide. Saved the curl output: https://gist.github.com/alex/def456

ben: ran `rg "kvcache" docs/ -n` -> hits in `docs/runtime/v2/index.md`, `docs/examples/cache-demo.md`, and `runbooks/kv-troubleshooting.md`.

alex: Redirect seems safest; minimal doc edits after. I can open PR for examples if needed.

doc-bot: link-scan: /runtime/v2/kvcache flagged dead on 2026-03-22. previous assignee: none.

maya: +1 on redirect. Use `scripts/add-redirect.sh` to add `/runtime/v2/kvcache -> /runtime/v2/kv-cache` then follow with docs edits.

ben: I'll make WIP PR with two commits: add redirect via script and replace occurrences. Patch snippet:

```bash
./scripts/add-redirect.sh "/runtime/v2/kvcache" "/runtime/v2/kv-cache" "tiny: normalize path"
rg -l "kvcache" docs/ | xargs sed -i 's|/runtime/v2/kvcache|/runtime/v2/kv-cache|g'
```

maya: great. Add a migration note in `runbooks/kv-troubleshooting.md` and mark redirect with 7-day TTL before pruning.

lina: schedule redirect during 48h maintenance window so SRE is aware. Add docs release note too.

ben: PR opened (WIP) and tagged reviewers @maya @lina — will post link here when ready.

alex: thanks, will re-run smoke tests after redirect lands to confirm.

lina: thumbs up. ping for rollback coordination if needed.
